styles.notes: Page: year = 4th & 5th numerical digits, month = 6th & 7th numerical digits. Character counting: year = normalized [3,5] = '03' -> 2003, month = [5,7] = '03' -> March. Digit-only counting is falsified: it would give year '31' (1931 below floor / 2031 future, no valid resolution).

styles.notes: Page: year = 4th & 5th digits, month = 6th & 7th digits. Character counting on the normalized serial (dash stripped): year = [3,5] = '99' -> 1999, month = [5,7] = '05' -> May. Digit-only counting is falsified: it would give month '50', invalid. Serial as printed: G6R9905-05028.
